Dear colleagues,
I hope this email finds you well!
As part of our Customer Service team's global initiative to clean up our
ticketing backlog, we're reaching out to help streamline our open cases.
During a recent review of our ISP ticketing system, we noticed several aging
tickets that need a quick status check. We're here to help make this process as
smooth as possible for you.
We've also noticed that this particular ticket hasn't seen recent activity for
an extended period. To help us keep our system streamlined and ensure we're
focusing on active issues, please note that if we don't receive an update within
one week from today, this ticket will be closed.
Would you be able to help us confirm:
* If the repair/resolution has been completed (I see on SCB that error is still
persisting, and last instructions from former NOC team didn't get any reply
from RC)
* Whether any follow-up actions are still pending
* Any relevant comments about the current situation
Don't worry about the administrative part - our central Customer Service team
will take care of closing the tickets once you confirm their status.
If you could add any brief comments that might be helpful for documentation and
provide your confirmation by replying to this email, that would be great!
Thanks so much for your help with this initiative! If you need any assistance or
have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0392132-DC/Si-D/TR- [MP / PD 170001187] DC1 Errorcode:6 CRM:03042000176
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0461773
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Highway Outlet-4
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
The error shown in the error flag is
Error Code 6
, which corresponds to
G_OUTLET_STAT_CODE_IMD_NOT_INITIALIZED – “Outlet not ready, insulation monitor not yet initialized.”
The IMD is randomly going into fault.
Please swap the two IMDs.
If the IMD is defective, outlet 2 should become inactive this week.
If not, please check the cables of IMD 1.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
